title: Snake wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='hat' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffde59'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff8a00'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='snake' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7ee86a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2fae4b'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- coiled body -->
  <path d='M22 82 C8 82 8 62 26 62 C46 62 46 82 66 82 C80 82 84 70 78 62 C72 54 58 56 56 66 C54 76 64 80 72 74'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#snake)' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- belly stripe on head area/neck -->
  <path d='M22 82 C8 82 8 62 26 62 C46 62 46 82 66 82 C80 82 84 70 78 62 C72 54 58 56 56 66 C54 76 64 80 72 74'
        fill='none' stroke='#c8f5a8' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='6 10'/>

  <!-- head raised at the top left of body coil -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='30' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#4fc464'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='30' rx='20' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#a5f08a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='33' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#3fb556'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='25' r='5' fill='#fff7cc'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='25' r='5' fill='#fff7cc'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='25' r='2.4' fill='#123018'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='25' r='2.4' fill='#123018'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d='M6 36 L-0 33 M6 36 L-0 39 M6 36 L-4 36' stroke='#ff5b7f' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M18 18 L30 -1 L42 18 Z' fill='url(#hat)'/>
  <path d='M21.5 12 L38.5 12' stroke='#ff4f8b' stroke-width='3'/>
  <path d='M23.5 7 L36.5 7' stroke='#5ec8ff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='-2' r='3' fill='#ff4f8b'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='14' r='1.6' fill='#fff7cc'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='10' r='1.6' fill='#fff7cc'/>
</svg>
